Nor Agriculture Multi Hop Questions Bench
	

This work is related to the project in adapting LLM to answer questions about Norwegian Agriculture in Norwegian. 
The dataset was generated using YourBench (v0.9.0), an open-source framework for generating domain-specific benchmarks from document collections. 
It needs further cleaning, verification in regards to citations and validation for diversity and topics coverage.
